name: Count
tagline: Pre-filled stocktake sheets, and no number lands until you sign off
description: A counting desk for small businesses doing physical inventory. It lays out tally sheets pre-filled with what is supposed to be on the shelf, then waits for a sign-off before any figure reaches the master stock file. The guard is the point: a mis-typed count can never quietly rewrite your records.
author: RichGarrick
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
